channel.title: Trailupbox — Latest Stories
channel.description: Daily movie & web series updates, release dates, spoiler-free reviews and recommendations.

item.title: Sir Patrick Stewart (1940–2026): Farewell to Captain Picard — and One Final Performance Still to Come
item.description: Sir Patrick Stewart has died at 86. The world says goodbye to Captain Picard and Professor X — but his farewell performance, already filmed for Avengers: Doomsday, is still to come this December.

item.title: Avatar Season 3 Is Already Filmed — So Why Is Netflix Hiding It Until 2027?
item.description: The final season of Netflix's live-action Avatar wrapped filming in November 2025 and has been finished for almost a year. Netflix has shown exactly one photo, released no trailer, and will only say '2027'. Here is everything actually confirmed.

item.title: Eiza González in a Backless Silver Monse Dress Held Up by a Single Strap at the TIME100 Next Gala
item.description: A backless silver sequin halter dress anchored by one single strap — Eiza González, herself a 2026 TIME100 Next honouree, delivered the gala's boldest engineering feat in Monse.

item.title: Joey King in Custom Mint Miu Miu at the TIME100 Next Gala
item.description: A mint-green off-the-shoulder gown scattered with embellishments, made custom by Miu Miu — Joey King, a 2026 TIME100 Next honouree, went full old-Hollywood softness in New York.

item.title: Kim Kardashian's Schiaparelli Gown Was Moulded From Liquid Silicone for the All's Fair Premiere
item.description: A plunging cream gown moulded from liquid silicone with hand-cut fringe over sequinned tulle — Kim Kardashian's Schiaparelli couture at the All's Fair Season 2 premiere in Mexico City was part dress, part sculpture.

item.title: Lupita Nyong'o Makes Black Velvet Irresistible in Brandon Maxwell at the WSJ. Innovator Awards
item.description: A black silk-velvet gown with a sculptural neckline, Bvlgari jewels and a red lip — Lupita Nyong'o's Brandon Maxwell moment at MoMA was a masterclass in doing more with less.

item.title: The Night Was Hers: Cynthia Erivo Honoured at the American Ballet Theatre Fall Gala in Erdem
item.description: A tailored black jacket and white shirt over a sweeping floral pannier skirt — Cynthia Erivo wore Erdem to the gala held in her honour, where Debbie Allen presented her award on stage.

item.title: Dune: Part Three's Final Trailer Puts a Target on the Emperor — and Chris Pratt Just Took Stephen King's Crown
item.description: The most powerful man in the universe just found out the plot to kill him runs through his own family. Plus a streaming king dethroned in six days, a record box-office run hitting its first speed bump, and a Friday so stacked you will need a plan.

item.title: Elle Fanning's Music-Box Moment: Robert Wun Couture at the Sunrise on the Reaping Premiere
item.description: A blush-pink tulle gown topped with a ballerina headpiece — Elle Fanning's London premiere look was pure Effie Trinket energy, and it was her first stop on the film's press tour.

item.title: Mckenna Grace Wore the Quarter Quell Arena Itself to the London Premiere
item.description: Look closer at Mckenna Grace's Almée Couture gown — it's embroidered with the film's arena itself: mountains, meadow and purple vines trailing into the train. Method dressing, taken literally.

item.title: Charlize Theron in Emerald Givenchy Fringe at Airbnb.org's First-Ever Gala
item.description: An emerald fringe gown from Givenchy's Spring 2027 collection, finished with black pom-pom heels — Charlize Theron owned the first Airbnb.org gala in Los Angeles.

item.title: A Family Night Out: Matthew McConaughey, Camila Alves and Son Levi at the Airbnb.org Gala
item.description: Matthew McConaughey and Camila Alves brought their 18-year-old son Levi along to Airbnb.org's first-ever gala in Los Angeles — and the family understood the assignment.

item.title: Best Movies of 2026: 7 New Movies You Can Watch Right Now — and #1 Cost More Than Any Korean Film in History
item.description: A kaiju classic reborn in 4K. A dinner party that turns into pure chaos. A Korean outbreak film from the director of Train to Busan. Our countdown of the seven best new movies you can watch right now — and exactly where to stream each one.

item.title: HOPE (2026) Review — No Spoilers: The Most Expensive Korean Movie Ever Made Split Cannes in Half
item.description: Ten years after The Wailing, Na Hong-jin returned with the most expensive Korean movie ever made — a monster epic so big and so strange that Cannes split right down the middle. Which side will you land on?

item.title: Severance Season 3: Why Apple Still Won't Announce the Release Date
item.description: Filming on Severance Season 3 has been underway since late July 2026, yet Apple TV+ has not said a single word about a premiere date. Here is everything we actually know — and why the silence might be deliberate.

item.title: Wednesday Season 3: Netflix Is Betting Bigger Than Ever
item.description: A wrapped shoot, a Paris chapter nobody will explain, and Winona Ryder joining the cast — Wednesday Season 3 is quietly shaping up to be Netflix's biggest swing yet on the Addams universe.

item.title: Zendaya's 2026 Is Stacked: Five Major Releases in a Single Year
item.description: The Odyssey, a new Spider-Man, Dune: Part Three, a new season of Euphoria and a fresh drama with Robert Pattinson — Zendaya's 2026 calendar is the kind most actors spread across a decade.

item.title: Severance Season 2 Review (Spoiler-Free): The Rare Sequel That Goes Deeper
item.description: Three years of waiting, and Severance Season 2 somehow justifies every day of it. A spoiler-free look at why this season hits harder, stranger and more emotionally than the first.
